columns.occurrence: nullable unique text; routineId:occurrenceDate or exam:name

mutation_guards.purpose: abort complete atomic batch on stale version; deleted before commit

relationEnforcement: server validates references; soft deletion preserves history. No SQL foreign keys over JSON fields.
dates: date-only fields YYYY-MM-DD Seoul calendar; execution receives explicit offset, normalizes UTC; actual time exact integer seconds
aggregation: selected plan nondeleted tasks due in inclusive selected dates; completed current boolean; delayed incomplete due before Seoul today; blocked distinct tasks with nonempty execution reason; estimated task minutes sum; actual all related execution seconds sum/60; difference actual-estimated; empty zero
export: one JSON containing schemaVersion/timezone/exportedAt/all records including soft-deleted/history/completions; excludes runtime secrets and internal request bodies
completeAction: POST action=complete,kind=task,id,version,requestId,execution:{start,end,activity or content,memo?,blockedReason}. Server sets taskId, requires positive actual duration, normalizes UTC and atomically writes task completed/cycle, execution, completion, history and idempotency result with executionId. Same request retries do not duplicate. Undo preserves execution history. Legacy toggle remains supported.
